item.title: Maestro 0.8.9
item.description:
## What's new
- Sparkle update checks remain enabled by default. You can disable scheduled checks in **Device Settings › Preferences**; manual **Check for Updates…** remains available. - This signed, notarized package verifies the complete Sparkle update path, including the USB helper and ThunderBridge components. - The signed Sparkle framework is included in the notarized PKG. Updates install the complete Maestro package, including the USB helper and ThunderBridge components. - Help now explains the two USB devices: **USB Audio** (16 inputs / 16 outputs) and **Maestro USB** (0 inputs / 16 outputs for keyboard volume control).
[Read the full release notes on GitHub](https://github.com/danielraffel/unofficial-symphony-maestro-mk1/releases/tag/v0.8.9)
